title.en: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra
title.th: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra

summary.en: Using GPT-6 Astra, Playco built three themed game prototypes from one grey box foundation and reported 50% fewer manual fixes than with the previous model.
